channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: What is the St Petersburg forum, Putin’s economic outreach to the world?
item.description: A Ukrainian drone strike targeted energy facilities near St Petersburg hours before the forum began.

item.title: Three British navy personnel killed in helicopter crash in England
item.description: An investigation under way after the deadly accident during a training exercise near the town of Sourton in Devon.

item.title: Iran’s World Cup squad to depart for Mexico on June 6 despite US visa delay
item.description: Squad's visas for the US haven't been issued, with Marco Rubio saying IRGC-linked members won't be allowed to 'embed'.

item.title: Kuwait and Bahrain attacked as Iran launches missile and drone barrage
item.description: Kuwait and Bahrain attacked as Iran launches missile and drone barrage

item.title: Iran, Kuwait, Bahrain hit: Is the war in the Gulf escalating again?
item.description: Secretary of State Rubio tells US lawmakers the war on Iran is over, amid recent attacks on Iran and Gulf countries.

item.title: One killed and dozens injured in Iranian drone strikes on Kuwait airport
item.description: Iran says the attack on Kuwait was in retaliation for earlier US strikes on an Iranian oil tanker and island.

item.title: Foreign nationals among at least 21 killed in Delhi fire
item.description: Many victims were South Asians who had travelled to India for treatment or to accompany relatives.

item.title: Eight killed after drone hits bus in Russian-occupied part of Ukraine
item.description: The bus was hit in the eastern Donetsk region, an official says.

item.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon but partial truce with Hezbollah appears to hold
item.description: Israel continues its campaign in the south, though has not struck Beirut after a deal announced by the US.

item.title: British couple lose Iran jail sentence appeal, family says
item.description: Lindsay and Craig Foreman were arrested in January 2025 during a global motorbike journey.
